label: helper requires fewer pages through first known target than baseline
sample_weight: absolute difference between baseline and helper page counts; ties have zero weight
loss: sample-weighted binary cross entropy; gradients use weights normalized to dataset mean one and batch sample count denominator
features: unchanged 12 runtime-only riido-search-claim-v1 features; no target rank, repository or auxiliary outcome
folds: test repo i, train (i+1)%3, validation (i+2)%3; ordered etcd-io/etcd, kubernetes/test-infra, lxc/lxd
selection: minimum validation weighted BCE; earliest tie
decision: score >= 0 proposes helper; not a calibrated probability or an action authority
primary: fp32 seed 1729, aggregate each held-out question exactly once
exploratory_gate: pages <= always-helper pages, auxiliary calls <= 90% of all questions, Recall1 and Recall10 >= raw baseline
replication: report seed 2718 separately; no selecting a winning seed
cost_scope: output page count only; no invented CPU-to-token conversion, billing savings or real agent verification claim
independence: Previously observed documentation questions from three repos, transductive code catalog; not a fresh final evaluation
